definitions.explanation: Free from error; conforming exactly to truth or to a standard.

examples.japanese: {正確|せいかく}な{情報|じょうほう}を{伝|つた}えてください。
この{時計|とけい}は{正確|せいかく}だ。
{正確|せいかく}に{言|い}うと、{三時|さんじ}{十五分|じゅうごふん}です。

notes:
{正確|せいかく} is a na-adjective meaning accurate or precise.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {正確|せいかく}に (accurately, precisely)
- Noun form: {正確|せいかく}さ (accuracy, precision)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正確|せいかく}な{情報|じょうほう} (accurate information)
- {正確|せいかく}な{数字|すうじ} (precise figures)
- {正確|せいかく}に{言|い}う (to be precise, to speak accurately)
- {時間|じかん}に{正確|せいかく} (punctual)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正確|せいかく}: accurate, precise (objective correctness)
- {精密|せいみつ}: precise, detailed (high precision)
- {的確|てきかく}: precise, on point (hitting the mark)

HOMOPHONES:
- {正確|せいかく}: accurate, precise
- {性格|せいかく}: personality, character
